subject: Candidate native Foundation borrow execution and hosted metadata integration
claim: The current-source native lowerer composes complete WVB 1.39 verification with bounded native admission. Record/u32 and allocated-text fixtures return 42 on Windows and Debian. The focused selection passes 26 cases per host: two native programs, nine invalid-borrow rejections, and fifteen enum-metadata envelope checks. Hosted packaging retains its five existing regression cases on each host. The existing native lowering owner also passes 37 cases on each host using the hash-identified current-source lowerer.

limitations: This is a development checkpoint, not complete native 1.39 or Libraries 1.0 qualification. Minor-39 system, unsafe write-region/write-pointer and Foreign admission remains unsupported.

The text fixture was freshly compiled through authenticated source admission on Windows and shared for these narrow native runs; this record does not claim new independent Debian source reconstruction.

Initial execution in a console-v1 container failed at a null text.concat service-table lookup (address 64). The existing hosted image packager supplies that intrinsic service. No payload-retention fix was inferred from that crash.

Enum metadata admission validates the envelope and existing supported nominal directory, not whole-module semantics. Full native verification remains prerequisite. Accepted older-version mutations are metadata tests only, not executable compatibility claims.

The E1 instruction-charge sizing correction and existing 37-case native lowering regression pass. Staging variants and clean bootstrap reconstruction remain unverified. Supplied-lowerer reuse checks the exact application hash; source provenance is recorded here rather than inferred from a digest.

The fresh-source Foundation selection was not repeated after the packaging candidate refresh; the narrow selector reuses the exact source fixture and lowerer products while executing changed behavior afresh.

PlanOnly selects a disproportionate 4185-second plan and a managed recovery coverage gap. It was not executed. Full development, frozen compiler qualification, browser and installed-tool qualification remain outside this checkpoint.
Owned Vector/native-resource payload execution, exclusive borrowing, Take/Map, maintained real-consumer migration, and the full goal remain pending.
